review_pass_1.method: Internal scientific and syllabus review of saved HTML, official CSIR PDFs, SET mirror, NCI/IUPHAR, historical PubMed records and review excerpts; not external peer review.
corrections: Clarified that cisplatin is not a literal alkyl donor, oxygen is not a requirement for all irradiation injury, checkpoint loss does not universally determine sensitivity, cytotoxicity includes delayed reproductive loss.
Expanded lesion complexity, repair/tissue recovery, historical evidence and study limitations, LQ model units and uncertainty, active metabolites, cell-cycle context and biological selectivity.
Verified Farber historical reference via PubMed PMID 18860765; distinguished aminopterin from methotrexate; verified Puck and Marcus PMID 13319584 and 13475608.
Recomputed examples and numerical answer keys after revisions.

corrections: Expanded narrative from 5,885 to 14,093 words through specific mechanistic and evidence passages, not templated padding.

Added 2 diagrams after first draft, adjusted figure order and arrows, added second comparison table, 8 worked examples, 16 recall prompts.
